name: Deck of Many Things

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Draw cards
powers.text: Declare how many cards you'll draw (1 to 4), then draw them one at a time; each card's magic takes hold at once.

summary: Draw from the deck and each card's fate falls on you, for great good or great ill.
text: Usually stored in a pouch or box, this deck's cards are made of ivory or vellum. Three decks in four (75 percent) hold 13 cards; the rest hold 22. Before drawing, you must announce how many cards you will draw, then draw that many at random; any card drawn past that number does nothing. Each card's magic takes effect the moment it is drawn, and each draw must come within 1 hour of the one before. Should you fail to draw the full number, the remaining cards leap from the deck by themselves and all take effect together. A drawn card fades away, but except for the Fool and the Jester it returns to the deck, so the same card can come up twice. The cards are Sun, Moon, Star, Comet, Void, Flames, Gem, Key, Knight, Rogue, Jester, Fool, Idiot, Vizier, Throne, Fates, Balance, Ruin, Skull, Talons, Donjon and Euryale.
